# EScooterwale — full electric scooter dataset for India

Source: https://www.escooterwale.in
Last updated: 2026-10-28
Models: 78 | Brands: 17

Prices are ex-showroom in Indian rupees unless stated. "Claimed range (IDC)" is the
manufacturer figure under the Indian Driving Cycle. "Real-world range" is EScooterwale's
own estimate for Normal/City mode with a single rider in mixed Indian city traffic, and
is consistently lower than the IDC claim. ScootScore is EScooterwale's independent 0-10
rating averaged across five published components.

## Real range test results (measured, March 2026)

Test conditions: identical 10 km Mumbai urban loop, single 72 kg rider, Normal/City mode,
mixed morning traffic, ambient 28-32°C, 100% to 0% state of charge.

| Rank | Model | Battery | IDC claim | Measured real range | Efficiency |
|------|-------|---------|-----------|---------------------|------------|
| 1 | TVS iQube ST | 5.3 kWh | 212 km | 165 km | 77.8% |
| 2 | Ola Electric S1 Pro+ | 5.2 kWh | 320 km | 155 km | 48.4% |
| 3 | Pure EV ETrance+ | 4.5 kWh | 171 km | 148 km | 86.5% |
| 4 | Ola Electric S1 Pro | 4 kWh | 176 km | 140 km | 79.5% |
| 5 | Ather Energy 450X | 3.7 kWh | 161 km | 125 km | 77.6% |
| 6 | Hero Vida V2 Pro | 3.94 kWh | 143 km | 118 km | 82.5% |
| 7 | Bajaj Chetak 3503 | 3.5 kWh | 153 km | 116 km | 75.8% |
| 8 | Ampere Nexus ST | 3 kWh | 136 km | 112 km | 82.4% |

Average IDC-to-real efficiency: 77.4%. Rule of thumb: multiply an IDC claim by 0.77 for a
Normal-mode city estimate, 0.9 for Eco mode, 0.65 for aggressive riding.

## Brands

### Ola Electric
- URL: https://www.escooterwale.in/brands/ola-electric
- Models: 8
- Founded: 2017
- Headquarters: Bengaluru
- Official site: https://www.olaelectric.com
- About: India's #1 EV scooter brand by sales. MoveOS 5 software, 36L boot, 90–117 km/h range across S1 series. Gen 3 launched 2026.

### Ather Energy
- URL: https://www.escooterwale.in/brands/ather-energy
- Models: 12
- Founded: 2013
- Headquarters: Bengaluru
- Official site: https://www.atherenergy.com
- About: India's premium EV brand. Best ride quality, Ather Grid fast-charging, 3.3 hr charge on 450X. Rizta is best-selling family scooter.

### TVS Motor
- URL: https://www.escooterwale.in/brands/tvs-motor
- Models: 8
- Founded: 1978
- Headquarters: Chennai
- Official site: https://www.tvsmotor.com
- About: India's most reliable EV service network — 4500+ centres nationwide. iQube ST 5.3 kWh delivers 212 km claimed range.

### Bajaj Chetak
- URL: https://www.escooterwale.in/brands/bajaj-chetak
- Models: 5
- Founded: 1945
- Headquarters: Pune
- Official site: https://www.chetak.com
- About: India's iconic scooter nameplate, revived electric. All-metal body, 35L boot, 4000+ dealers. C2501 to 3503 — 5 variants.

### Hero Vida
- URL: https://www.escooterwale.in/brands/hero-vida
- Models: 6
- Founded: 2022
- Headquarters: New Delhi
- Official site: https://www.vidaworld.com
- About: Hero MotoCorp's EV arm. 6000+ Hero service points. VX2 has removable battery (BaaS model). Best hero service coverage in India.

### Ampere
- URL: https://www.escooterwale.in/brands/ampere
- Models: 4
- Founded: 2008
- Headquarters: Coimbatore
- Official site: https://ampere-electric.com
- About: India's oldest EV brand (2008). 5000+ dealers in 500+ cities. LFP batteries in Nexus range. Tier-2/3 India's most accessible EV.

### Okinawa
- URL: https://www.escooterwale.in/brands/okinawa
- Models: 6
- Founded: 2015
- Headquarters: Gurugram
- Official site: https://okinawascooters.com
- About: 10 years EV experience. 700+ dealers. Budget to mid-range. Okhi-90 is only Okinawa with 90 km/h. Entry R30 starts at ₹61,998.

### Pure EV
- URL: https://www.escooterwale.in/brands/pure-ev
- Models: 7
- Founded: 2019
- Headquarters: Hyderabad
- Official site: https://pureev.in
- About: IIT Hyderabad incubated. ETrance+ has 3G LTE, best real range in budget segment. Swappable batteries available.

### Bounce Infinity
- URL: https://www.escooterwale.in/brands/bounce-infinity
- Models: 2
- Founded: 2021
- Headquarters: Bengaluru
- Official site: https://www.bounceev.com
- About: Battery-swap pioneer. E1 is India's lowest-priced EV with swap support. BaaS model eliminates battery cost upfront.

### BGauss
- URL: https://www.escooterwale.in/brands/bgauss
- Models: 6
- Founded: 2020
- Headquarters: Mumbai
- Official site: https://www.bgauss.com
- About: RR Kabel backed Mumbai EV brand. Premium build quality above price. D15i and RUV 350i are flagship models.

### Honda
- URL: https://www.escooterwale.in/brands/honda
- Models: 1
- Founded: 1999
- Headquarters: Gurugram
- Official site: https://www.honda2wheelersindia.com
- About: Honda Motorcycle & Scooter India is the Indian two-wheeler arm of Honda Motor Co. Its electric scooters are sold under the e: line through dedicated EV dealers.

### Suzuki
- URL: https://www.escooterwale.in/brands/suzuki
- Models: 1
- Founded: 2006
- Headquarters: Gurugram
- Official site: https://www.suzukimotorcycle.co.in
- About: Suzuki Motorcycle India is the Indian two-wheeler subsidiary of Suzuki Motor Corporation. The e-Access, built at its Gurugram plant, is its first electric scooter.

### Simple Energy
- URL: https://www.escooterwale.in/brands/simple-energy
- Models: 3
- Founded: 2019
- Headquarters: Bengaluru
- Official site: https://www.simpleenergy.in
- About: Simple Energy is a Bengaluru based electric two-wheeler maker that builds its scooters at a plant in Hosur, Tamil Nadu. Its range covers the Simple One, Simple Ultra and the family oriented Simple Wave.

### Kinetic
- URL: https://www.escooterwale.in/brands/kinetic-watts-volts
- Models: 2
- Founded: 2022
- Headquarters: Pune
- Official site: https://www.kineticev.in
- About: Kinetic Watts and Volts Ltd. is the EV subsidiary of Kinetic Engineering Ltd., set up in 2022, and makes the electric Kinetic DX scooter at Ahmednagar, Maharashtra. It is a separate company from Kinetic Green.

### Lectrix
- URL: https://www.escooterwale.in/brands/lectrix
- Models: 2
- Founded: null
- Headquarters: Gurugram
- Official site: https://www.lectrixev.com
- About: Lectrix E-Vehicle Pvt. Ltd. is the electric two-wheeler brand of the SAR Group, which also owns Livguard and Livpure. Its head office is in Udyog Vihar, Gurugram, Haryana.

### OPG Mobility (Okaya)
- URL: https://www.escooterwale.in/brands/okaya-ev
- Models: 3
- Founded: null
- Headquarters: Gurugram
- Official site: https://opgmobility.com
- About: OPG Mobility is the electric vehicle business formerly sold as Okaya EV, which rebranded in 2025. It sells electric scooters, an electric motorcycle and electric three-wheelers, with its corporate office in Gurugram, Haryana.

### VLF
- URL: https://www.escooterwale.in/brands/vlf
- Models: 2
- Founded: null
- Headquarters: Kolhapur
- Official site: https://motohaus.in/product-category/vlf
- About: VLF is an Italian scooter brand whose scooters are built in Zhejiang, China. In India it is sold and serviced by MotoHaus, based in Kolhapur, which brought the brand to India in 2024.

### Ola Electric S1 X 2 kWh
- URL: https://www.escooterwale.in/scooters/ola-electric-s1-x-2-kwh
- Ex-showroom price: ₹89,999
- Estimated on-road price from: ₹95,620 (lowest across our 12 cities; varies by state road tax)
- EMI from: ₹2370/month
- Battery: 2 kWh
- Claimed range (IDC): 108 km
- Real-world range (EScooterwale estimate): 80–90 km
- Top speed: 101 km/h
- Charging time: 4.5 hrs
- Kerb weight: 105 kg
- Boot space: 34 L
- Ground clearance: 160 mm
- Seat height: 791 mm
- ScootScore: 8/10 (Range 4.9, Features 9, Value 8.6, Ride 7.5, Service 6.5)
- Verdict: The Ola S1 X (2 kWh) delivers 108 km claimed range at ₹89,999. MoveOS 5 software, 7-inch touchscreen, and Ola's performance heritage. Service in metros is solid; Tier-2 still improving.
- Best for: Tech-forward buyers in metro cities; Daily commutes needing 80–90 km real range
- Avoid if: Tier-2 city buyers without Ola service; Buyers who prefer physical controls
